content.text:
MISSION SUCCESS: Rocket Lab Launches 97th Electron Mission: Rocket Lab says the 'Owlright Owlright Owlright' mission launched at 12:39 p.m. NZST on September 26, delivered Synspective's 13th StriX satellite to orbit, and was Electron's 97th launch and Rocket Lab's 18th launch of 2026. (time=2026-09-26; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
MISSION SUCCESS: Rocket Lab Launches 96th Electron Mission: The search result identifies the prior Electron mission as the 96th and dates that launch to September 19, 2026. The exact original publication time was not established. (time=UNKNOWN; cutoff=UNKNOWN).
Iridium Communications Inc. Form 8-K — September 24, 2026: The filing records approval of the merger agreement: 85,862,105 votes for, 318,415 against, and 67,862 abstentions. It says the mergers were expected to close in mid-2027, subject to remaining closing conditions including regulatory approvals. (time=2026-09-24; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates Rocket Lab stock rating on launch record: The page reports Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated an Overweight rating, citing launch record, customer diversification, and dedicated launch sites, and names Neutron's first launch and the Iridium acquisition close as upcoming catalysts. It is not Cantor's original research note. (time=2026-09-28 08:08 AM (timezone not stated); cutoff=UNKNOWN).
Cantor Backs Rocket Lab’s Launch Momentum After 97th Electron Mission – Highlights These ‘Competitive Advantages’: The article summarizes Cantor's reiterated rating and competitive-advantage comments, the completed 97th mission, the Iridium vote, and Starship's first orbital flight and satellite deployment. Its 1:15 p.m. EDT publication time is before cutoff; the case-provided copy is timestamped 17:15:46Z. (time=2026-09-28T17:15:46Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
